reader.explanation: The published theorem writes the polynomial factor in graph order n. On standard explicit unweighted inputs, one can normalize the budget to at most n − 1 and relabel vertices, so all threshold queries have length polynomial in n. Polynomially many such queries recover the minimum cost.
